description.purpose: List the predicates (yes-or-no checks) and value functions the world model declares.
description.returns: Each one's identifier, summary and the arguments it takes.
description.use_when: Looking for a check or a computed value about individuals; asking about a kind includes those taking any kind it specialises, so ask once for the most specific kind you hold.

about.description: A kind's identifier, or its plain name when no other kind shares it.
